_comment: Filed at adjudication, not at completion (owner, 2026-10-30, option E on cat-harness#686). Spec: the spec-kit comment on litlfred/folio-assistant#875, Adjudicated by the owner 2026-10-29 11:33Z (card "A. Accept all four, then build"). Implementation: https://github.com/litlfred/cat-harness-tools/pull/837 (src/tools/skill-update.ts and its tests); definition: tools/skill-update/. Graduated to `in-force` 2026-10-30 once FR-005 was settled (owner, option A: the activity is kept on the workflow step) and built in litlfred/cat-harness-tools#887. Bean cat-tools-ycn6.
title: A skill edit goes through a governed Tool, not a raw file write
description: An agent edits an existing local skill only through the skill-update Tool. The Tool resolves the skill as skill-fetch does, gates the write (permission, parse, name, references, base hash), writes the working tree for the agent to commit, and reports every gate's verdict. Creating, renaming or deleting a skill is out of scope.

statements.label: The Tool is declared in the harness and implemented in the tools layer
statements.requirement: A skill-update Tool SHALL be declared in cat-harness/tools/ and implemented in cat-harness-tools/src/tools/, next to skill-fetch (FR-001).

successCriteria.criterion: The skill-update Tool node shows in the Tool QA report with zero missing criteria (FR-008).

statements.label: It edits exactly the file skill-fetch serves
statements.requirement: The Tool SHALL resolve (package_name, skill) with the resolver skill-fetch uses, not a second one, and an unknown skill SHALL be reported as skill-fetch reports it (FR-002).

successCriteria.criterion: An unknown skill is refused and the result names the packages searched, as skill-fetch does.

statements.label: Nothing is written unless every gate is satisfied
statements.requirement: The Tool SHALL NOT write unless the actor is granted skill-update by a policy, the new front matter parses and keeps the skill's name, every added reference resolves, and the file still matches the hash the caller read. A gate that cannot decide SHALL refuse (FR-003; owner answer 3).

successCriteria.criterion: A write citing a missing skill or file is refused every time in the test suite.
A refused write leaves the file byte-identical.
An added external link that cannot be checked refuses the write.

statements.label: Every call says what it did and why
statements.requirement: Every call SHALL return the file path, each gate's verdict with its reason, and either a diff summary or the reason nothing was written. Every gate runs, so one call reports every problem (FR-004).

successCriteria.criterion: A call that fails several gates reports each of them.

statements.label: An accepted write leaves a PROV-O activity on its workflow step
statements.requirement: An accepted write made as a named process step SHALL return a PROV-O activity whose plan is that step, and workflow_complete SHALL keep it on the step's history entry; an activity naming another step, or not a prov:Activity, SHALL refuse the call. A refused write leaves no activity: it did not happen (FR-005, reworded by the owner 2026-10-30, option A).

successCriteria.criterion: Every agent-authored skill change made as a process step is matched by an activity on that step's history entry.
An activity whose plan names another step, or that is not a prov:Activity, refuses workflow_complete and records nothing.

statements.label: Reference packages, generated files and other layers are refused
statements.requirement: The Tool SHALL refuse to write a reference (external) package, a generated file (naming its generator), or a skill that lives in another repository or an untracked mounted copy (naming the owning repository) (FR-006; owner answer 4).

successCriteria.criterion: Writes to a reference package, a generated file, another repository's skill and an untracked copy are each refused.

statements.label: Only the skill's instruction file is written
statements.requirement: The Tool SHALL NOT write any knowledge-graph node other than the skill's instruction file (FR-007).

successCriteria.criterion: An accepted write changes exactly one file, the resolved skill file.

statements.label: A write edits the working tree, and the agent commits it
statements.requirement: An accepted write SHALL change the working tree only; the agent commits it through its normal flow (FR-009; owner answer 1).

successCriteria.criterion: An accepted write makes no commit and opens no branch.

statements.label: Only Roles the owner grants may write a skill
statements.requirement: Writing a skill SHALL need the skill-update permission, which no default policy grants and no sibling permission stands in for; an unknown grant is not a permit, and a prohibition refuses even with a grant (FR-010; owner answer 2).

successCriteria.criterion: With no policy granting skill-update, a write is refused; content-authoring does not stand in; a prohibition wins over a grant.
